words.page.title: ThoughtKnot: turn what you know into a map you can see
words.page.description: Free, open-source tool that draws what you know as a map you can see, change and share. In Obsidian now. An app, VS Code and a library come next.
words.nav.label: Project links
words.hero.title: Turn what you know into a map you can see
words.hero.lede: Write things and the links between them as plain text, and ThoughtKnot draws them. Change the graph by typing, or by tapping and dragging the drawing. It works in Obsidian today. A standalone app, a VS Code plugin and a JavaScript library come next.
words.features.title: What it does
words.features.edit.title: Type it or drag it
words.features.edit.text: Edit the graph as text beside the note, or move and link things on the drawing. Both change the same note.
words.features.views.title: Seven ways to see it
words.features.views.text: Show the same graph as a network, a tree, a flow, a radial map, lanes, a timeline or a table.
words.features.problems.title: Problems, with their fixes
words.features.problems.text: A missing link or an unknown kind is shown on the drawing, with a fix you can apply in one step.
words.features.offline.title: Offline and private
words.features.offline.text: Everything runs on your device. No account, no tracking, no update checks. AI is off until you set up a model yourself.
words.features.devices.title: Desktop and mobile
words.features.devices.text: Works wherever Obsidian runs, with the keyboard, a mouse or touch, in light and dark themes.
words.features.open.title: An open format
words.features.open.text: Graphs are plain text in your notes. The format has free libraries in JavaScript and Python, so other tools can read it too.
words.start.title: How to start
words.start.download: Download main.js, manifest.json and styles.css from the latest release.
words.start.copy: Put them in your vault, in the folder .obsidian/plugins/thoughtknot.
words.start.enable: In Obsidian, open Settings, then Community plugins, and turn on ThoughtKnot.
words.start.status: ThoughtKnot is still being built, so expect changes. It is not yet listed in Obsidian's community plugins.
words.more.title: Find out more
words.more.guide: The guide: how to use ThoughtKnot, with pictures
words.more.roadmap: The roadmap: what is done and what comes next
words.more.help: Get help, ask a question or report a problem in GitHub Discussions, open to everyone
words.footer.licence: Free and open source under the Mozilla Public License 2.0.
words.footer.trademark: ThoughtKnot is an independent project and is not made by Obsidian.
words.demo.title: Try ThoughtKnot: the project's own graphs, live
words.demo.description: ThoughtKnot running in your browser, drawing the graphs the project is built from. Change views, find things and edit the graph. Nothing is sent or kept.
words.demo.heading: Try ThoughtKnot in your browser
words.demo.lede: These are the project's own graph notes, drawn by the same plugin you get from the latest release. Change the view, find a thing, or edit the first graph in the pane.
words.demo.private: It all runs on this page. Nothing you type is sent or kept, so a reload starts afresh. The first visit loads about 1.5 MB.
words.demo.noscript: The demo needs JavaScript. The guide shows the same graphs in pictures.
words.privacy.title: Privacy: ThoughtKnot keeps nothing about you
words.privacy.description: What ThoughtKnot keeps, where it keeps it, for how long, and how to delete it. It collects no data about you, and sends your words to an AI model only when you set one up and press Send.
words.privacy.heading: Privacy
words.privacy.lede: ThoughtKnot collects no data about you. It has no account, no analytics, no tracking and no update checks. This page covers the Obsidian plugin, the desktop app and the browser editor.
words.privacy.kept.title: What is kept, and where
words.privacy.kept.notes: Your notes stay in your own files, on your device: your Obsidian vault, or the folder you open in the app. They are kept for as long as you keep those files. To delete them, delete the files.
words.privacy.kept.settings: Your settings stay on your device too, in Obsidian's data for the plugin. Uninstall the plugin to delete them. The app keeps the folder it has open only while it runs.
words.privacy.kept.nothing: Nothing is sent to us. There is no server of ours, so we never see your notes, your settings or how you use ThoughtKnot.
words.privacy.ai.title: AI models: the one place your words can go
words.privacy.ai.off: AI is off until you turn it on and set up a model yourself. Nothing is ever sent in the background.
words.privacy.ai.send: Before anything goes, you see what will be sent and to which model. Nothing goes until you press Send.
words.privacy.ai.where: A model on your own device keeps your words on your device. A model at a remote address receives the words you send. Its provider keeps them under its own terms, so they leave our control once sent.
words.privacy.ai.record: Each send is recorded on your device without the words sent: the time, the model, the size and the result. The last 200 sends are kept. A command clears them.
words.privacy.ai.keys: A model's key stays in Obsidian's own store for secrets. It is never written to a note, a setting or a log.
words.privacy.site.title: This website
words.privacy.site.text: This site sets no cookies and runs no analytics. GitHub Pages hosts it, and GitHub may keep logs of visits under GitHub's own privacy statement.
words.privacy.contact.title: Questions
words.privacy.contact.text: Ask about privacy in GitHub Discussions, open to everyone.

words.privacy.kept.drafts: A change not yet saved is kept as a draft on your device. It goes once it is saved or thrown away.
